title: Librus Synergia — Smart Home With Me

user.title: Connect Librus Synergia
user.description: Enter the student's Librus Synergia credentials. This is an unofficial integration.

reconfigure.title: Update credentials
reconfigure.description: Change the password for Librus account **{username}** without removing the integration or its entities.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Librus
reauth_confirm.description: Librus rejected the saved credentials for **{username}**. Enter the current password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not sign in to Librus. Check the credentials and Librus availability.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant logs.
error.invalid_auth: Librus rejected the username or password.

abort.already_configured: This Librus account is already configured.

init.title: Data refresh
init.description: In automatic mode the integration adapts the polling interval to the time of day. You can also force a fixed interval. Manual refresh buttons remain available.

data_description.refresh_mode: Automatic: 5 min on weekdays 06:00–18:00, 15 min 18:00–22:00, 30 min on weekends 06:00–22:00 and 60 min at night.
data_description.data_refresh_interval: Used only in Custom interval mode. Range: 5–360 minutes.
data_description.timetable_refresh_interval: Interval in minutes (30–720). Default: 120 minutes. Additional checks at 04:00 and 20:30 remain active.
